channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Haddad diz que 'até a mãe de Cristo não escapou do bolsonarismo' e ataca Tarcísio
item.description: PT gubernatorial candidate Fernando Haddad stated at a São Paulo event with Lula that 'even Christ's mother couldn't escape Bolsonarism,' criticizing disrespect toward faith and women. The remark, made during the 'Juntas com Haddad e Lula' rally in Praça da Sé, targeted Tarcísio and the Bolsonarist legacy.

item.title: Flávio diz que ala da CNBB articulou com PT fake news sobre N. S. Aparecida
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused members of CNBB of conspiring with PT to spread fake news about Our Lady of Aparecida. The allegation was made during his tenure as senator and presidential candidate for PL. CNBB has not officially commented on the accusation so far.

item.title: Campo Coletivo cria plataforma para discutir democracia com jovens
item.description: CampoColetivo.com is a free digital platform created to promote discussions on democracy, citizenship, and Brazilian history through the arts. Developed by Isabella Prata, Muriel, and Michele Matalon, it features content from cinema, literature, music, theater, dance, architecture, and visual arts aimed at engaging young people.

item.title: Lula cita reservas internacionais e diz que dívida pública não lhe provoca 'pânico'
item.description: Lula stated that public debt does not cause him panic and labeled concerns about it as unrealistic, emphasizing the use of international reserves as a strategy to stabilize the economy. The comment was made in a previewed interview during his re-election campaign.

item.title: Dallagnol volta a ter acesso ao Instagram, mas continua proibido de fazer campanha
item.description: Deltan Dallagnol regained access to Instagram after a judicial decision suspended by the TSE, but remains prohibited from campaigning. The candidate for senator from Paraná shared a video on X announcing the reactivation of his account through a new judicial decision.

item.title: Lula cita boa relação com Trump, mas diz que 'pessoal que trabalha com ele' é 'muito ruim'
item.description: Lula stated he has a good personal relationship with Trump but criticized his supporting team as 'very bad'. In an interview with Canal Livre, he did not rule out an alliance for 2026 but emphasized ideological differences. The statement comes amid the pre-election context.

item.title: Flávio confirma ida a debate da Globo, chama Lula para confronto e critica decisão sobre bets
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed his participation in the TV Globo presidential debate and challenged Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to a direct confrontation, criticizing the jury's decision regarding bets in the event.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro confirma ida ao debate da Globo e desafia Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed his participation in the TV Globo debate and challenged Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to join, calling him a 'liar' and 'killer of Brazil's hope'. Lula has not confirmed attendance, following a strategy of avoiding direct debates, as happened in 2006. Their absence led to the cancellation of the Record debate.

item.title: Em entrevista, o presidente Lula diz que Congresso 'contribuiu' para governabilidade
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated in an interview with TV Bandeirantes that the National Congress contributed significantly to the governance of Brazil over the past four years, highlighting the approval of the Tax Reform as an example of changes desired by the government. He emphasized the collaborative role of the Legislative branch in advancing his agenda.

item.title: Com Arruda fora, PSD vai declarar apoio a Celina
item.description: Following the TSE's rejection of José Roberto Arruda's (PSD) gubernatorial candidacy for the Federal District, the PSD-DF will officially support Celina Leão's (PP) re-election. The announcement is scheduled for Monday (28/9), confirmed by PSD-DF president Paulo Octávio. Candidates from the party and Arruda himself remain free to endorse whomever they choose in the majoritarian race.

item.title: Padroeira do Brasil e proibição de bets desviam foco do STF a 7 dias da eleição
item.description: The Banco Master scandal involving STF authorities diverts attention from Lula's campaign 7 days before the election, benefiting him in trends with positive themes like the ban on bets and Our Lady of Aparecida.

item.title: Dino rasga o CPP, a Constituição, destrói o TSE e dá uma forcinha para Lula
item.description: Flávio Dino, a Supreme Federal Court justice, unilaterally ruled on an electoral matter, disregarding TSE's autonomy and undermining constitutional principles. Critics argue the decision benefits Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, reinforcing judicial interference in electoral affairs. The justice's confrontational approach to constitutional and electoral bodies has sparked controversy.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que ‘PT conseguiu levantar fake news com ajuda de gente de dentro da CNBB’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused the PT of spreading fake news about the alleged removal of Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint, claiming help from CNBB members. He also criticized minister Flávio Dino's decisions at the STF, calling them a defense of PT's 'lie league'.

item.title: Flávio diz que CNBB ajudou PT a espalhar fake news sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) accused the PT of using support from CNBB members to spread a fake news about the alleged intention to remove Our Lady of Aparecida's title as Patroness of Brazil. He emphasized the information is false and questioned the Church's credibility in politics. The statement occurs amid religious polarization ahead of the elections.

item.title: Deltan recupera Instagram, mas segue proibido de fazer campanha
item.description: Deltan Dallagnol (Novo) regained access to Instagram after a court decision but remains prohibited by the TSE from campaigning, including vote requests and electoral propaganda. The Senate candidate from Paraná shared content on social media, emphasizing the ongoing judicial restrictions.

item.title: "Tentativa de homicídio", diz Flávio após carreata ser atingida por ovos
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign rally in Goiânia was targeted with eggs thrown by residents, prompting him to label the incident as attempted homicide. He also accused the PT and the CNBB of spreading fake news regarding alleged plans to remove Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint.

item.title: Ministério pede ao Telegram bloqueio de 43 perfis que divulgam apostas e cassinos virtuais ilegais
item.description: The Ministry of Justice requested the removal of 43 profiles on Telegram that promote illegal bets and online casinos, aligning with the provisional measure banning bets in Brazil. The action is part of a broader campaign including requests to the telecom regulator to block over 500 illegal betting sites and a bill sent to Congress criminalizing online gambling operations. These measures were announced nine days before the 2026 elections, reinforcing President Lula's stance against illegal gambling.

item.title: Flávio diz que irá ao debate na Globo, o último antes do 1º turno; Lula não está confirmado
item.description: Flávio D'Avila confirmed his participation in the last presidential debate on Globo before the first round of 2026, while Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva remains unconfirmed. Following cancellations due to leading candidates absent, only one debate is scheduled for the first round, with no guarantee of all candidates attending.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que vai ao debate na Globo mesmo que Lula não vá
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he will attend the TV Globo debate scheduled for October 1st, even if Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva does not show up. While campaigning in Goiânia, he invited Lula to debate and confirmed his own participation. So far, neither candidate has confirmed attendance in first-round debates.

item.title: 415 bets ilegais surgem no Brasil após proibição, mostra monitoramento
item.description: Following the government's ban on online betting, 415 new illegal betting sites were identified, with a 141% increase in just two days. The Bet Legal platform, in partnership with Iron Security, has been tracking the creation of unauthorized sites operating without the license of the Secretariat of Prizes and Betting.

item.title: "Fake news sobre Nossa Senhora teve ajuda de dentro da CNBB”, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused the PT and members of the CNBB of spreading fake news about a supposed plan to remove the title of Patroness of Brazil from Our Lady of Aparecida. He also criticized judicial decisions allowing controversial YouTube posts to remain, claiming this supports the PT's 'lie league'.

item.title: Flávio anuncia ida ao debate da Globo e desafia Lula: ‘Quero esfregar verdades na cara dele’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) confirmed his participation in the TV Globo debate, challenging Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) to attend. During a campaign event in Goiânia, he stated that Lula is his only opponent and expressed intent to 'rub truths' in the face of the PT leader. Flávio had previously avoided debates under the claim that he only wanted to debate with Lula.

item.title: Dino e Gilmar criam sistema de escolha de juiz no período eleitoral
item.description: Supreme Court justices Flávio Dino and Gilmar Mendes employ an unregulated mechanism to cherry-pick favorable electoral cases, bypassing the traditional random assignment of rapporteurs. Known as 'complainant chooses old action', this allows parties to select past cases with favorable rulings and file incidental petitions. President Edson Fachin's omission has intensified criticism over this institutional flaw.

item.title: Flávio chama polícia após carreata ser atingida por ovos em Goiânia
item.description: During a campaign rally in Goiânia, the convoy of senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) was hit by eggs thrown by residents of Jardim Goiás. Flávio reacted angrily, asking police to identify the perpetrators and calling the act an attempted murder. At the end of the event, he accused the PT and the CNBB of spreading fake news about a supposed plan to remove Our Lady of Aparecida's title as patron saint of Brazil, and criticized minister Flávio Dino's decision regarding a post by humorist Antonio Tabet.

item.title: Nova pesquisa AtlasIntel testa a disputa Lula x Flávio no maior colégio eleitoral do Brasil
item.description: AtlasIntel will release a new electoral poll on October 3rd, ahead of the first round, focusing on the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro among São Paulo voters. The survey will simulate direct matchups between the main presidential candidates and also measure voting intentions for governor and senator. A total of 2,200 voters will be interviewed between September 27th and October 2nd via a demographically adjusted online questionnaire.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro confirma ida a debate da Globo e chama Lula para confronto
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed his participation in the TV Globo presidential debate and challenged Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to a direct confrontation. He criticized the federal government's ban on sports betting, arguing it harms the market and advertising for sports events. During the event in Goiânia, he requested police assistance following provocations from protesters.

item.title: Lula quer criar “polícia especial” contra o crime organizado
item.description: Lula proposed creating a 'special police' linked to a Ministry of Public Security to combat organized crime, emphasizing the need for a stronger National Force. He distinguished factions like PCC and Comando Vermelho from terrorist organizations while advocating for greater integration between the federal, state, and municipal levels of security.

item.title: Romário desmente vídeo falso sobre Lula, Flamengo e bets. Entenda
item.description: Romário denied a fake video attributing statements to him about Lula, Flamengo, and sports betting, stating that AI was used to simulate his voice. His team announced they will take legal action against those responsible for producing and spreading the content.

item.title: AGU defende garantia de livre acesso à internet nas 72h anteriores às eleições
item.description: The AGU filed a lawsuit with the STF to guarantee unrestricted mobile internet access in the 72 hours before elections, regardless of data limits. The measure seeks to protect neutral information access and ensure full political participation of voters.

item.title: Lula defende mudar indicação ao STF: “Quando coloca toga, vira Deus”
item.description: Lula proposed changing the model for appointing Supreme Court ministers, suggesting the creation of a collegial body with civil society participation to evaluate names before the presidential nomination. He highlighted that the experience of appointing ministers who later make independent decisions influenced his proposal. The president also emphasized that the current Constitution allows the president to appoint ministers, with Senate approval.

item.title: Boulos percorre periferias de SP e região metropolitana em uma van para pedir votos a Lula
item.description: Guilherme Boulos (PSOL) travels through the outskirts of São Paulo in a van to mobilize votes for President Lula (PT), while on leave from the Secretariat-General of the Presidency. The action reinforces leadership alliance and seeks popular support in peripheral neighborhoods. The campaign highlights social priorities and progressive policies.

item.title: Dino age para “descredenciar” o TSE, diz defesa de Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's legal team criticized Minister Flávio Dino's decision, which revoked an injunction and allowed Antônio Tabet's post about Our Lady of Aparecida, accusing the judiciary of losing credibility. The campaign filed a lawsuit to prevent ads linking Flávio to a proposal to remove the country's patron saint.

item.title: STF tira federação PSDB-Cidadania de coligação de Raquel Lyra em Pernambuco
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Dias Toffoli ordered the removal of the PSDB-Cidadania Federation from Raquel Lyra's coalition in Pernambuco. Lyra's campaign announced it will appeal the court ruling.

item.title: Dino usa precedente sobre liberdade de imprensa para liberar posts sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: STF Minister Flávio Dino used a press freedom precedent to allow posts regarding an alleged plot by candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to remove the title of Patroness of Brazil from Our Lady of Aparecida. Bolsonaro denied any intention to take such action.

item.title: Lula defende revogação do Fundo Eleitoral para encerrar a 'promiscuidade política'
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advocated for the revocation of the Electoral Fund to combat 'political promiscuity', arguing that current legislation allows corrupt and unequal campaign financing practices. He proposes changes to electoral regulation to increase transparency.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro se diz 'perplexa' com decisão de Dino sobre posts de Nossa Senhora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign criticized Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino's decision to remove posts featuring Our Lady containing allegedly offensive statements. The statement expressed concern over religious censorship and defended freedom of expression.

item.title: Em agenda, Cappelli promete isenção de IPVA para motoristas de aplicativos
item.description: Ricardo Cappelli (PSB) pledged IPVA exemption and a GDF-owned app, Bora DF, with maximum 10% trip fees for ride-hailing and delivery drivers. He also proposed vehicle insurance through Banco de Brasília and cooperative management of the platform.

item.title: Lula defende acabar com fundo eleitoral para Brasil ter "política sadia"
item.description: President Lula advocates for abolishing the electoral fund and enacting comprehensive political reform to strengthen parties with ethics and programs. He also proposes a special police force and the National Force to combat organized crime, especially high-level crime.

item.title: Veja como foi o final de semana dos candidatos à presidência
item.description: On the 26th and 27th, the presidential candidates held street events across the country, with special emphasis on Lula, who defended the ban on online betting and criticized agribusiness; Zema and Caiado also campaigned in Minas Gerais and Goiás, addressing rural credit and religious freedom.

item.title: "Ou acabava com as bets, ou elas acabavam com o povo", afirma Leandro Grass
item.description: Leandro Grass, PT candidate for DF governor, supports Lula's ban on bets, claiming it prevented family debt. Celina Leão, DF governor and PP re-election candidate, criticized the measure as political opportunism. The provisional measure signed by Lula provides for the return of R$1.7 billion to bettors and the end of sports betting in the country.

item.title: Confira todos os vencedores do fim de semana no Autódromo de Brasília
item.description: Over the weekend at Brasília International Track, Sérgio Sette Câmara and Lucas di Grassi won the Stock Car endurance race, while Gabriel Koenigkan secured the Stock Light championship. The event also featured Formula 4 and Turismo Nacional categories, with wins going to Fausto Arnaudo, Bernardo Gentil, João Cardoso, and Luiz Veras.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio liga fake news da padroeira a criador de Dilma Bolada
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign accuses Jeferson de Oliveira Monteiro, creator of the 'Dilma Bolada' profile, of leading a disinformation campaign about an alleged proposal to remove Our Lady of Aparecida's title as Patroness of Brazil. The complaint cites 29 profiles and requests an investigation by the Electoral Prosecutor's Office for possible electoral crimes.

item.title: Lula defende a criação de uma ‘polícia especial’ contra o crime organizado
item.description: President Lula advocated for the creation of a 'special police' force and a Ministry of Public Security to combat organized crime, describing criminal factions as 'a multinational industry'. He proposed economically strangling these groups and targeting their leadership, which he claims is infiltrated in institutions such as the judiciary, police, and politics.

item.title: Os temas abordados por Lula em programa eleitoral na reta final da campanha
item.description: Lula released an electoral program comparing himself to Flávio Bolsonaro and emphasizing measures for workers, such as rest time, education, and cost of life reduction. Each letter of 'Lula' symbolizes proposals like fighting violence, universal education, and salary increase. The speech extends beyond partisan identity, emphasizing trust in the country.

item.title: Lula defende ‘polícia especial’ contra o crime organizado e fim do Fundo Eleitoral
item.description: Lula proposed creating a federal special police to combat organized crime and a dedicated ministry for public security, criticizing previous military interventions. He advocated for the revocation of the Electoral Fund, arguing that U.S. state terrorism should not be confused with tackling Brazilian criminal factions.

item.title: Lula muda ato na Bahia e PT baiano atribui decisão a Janja
item.description: Lula's campaign moved the final event in Bahia from Feira de Santana to Salvador, focusing on capital cities. The decision was attributed to First Lady Janja by PT members, opposing a faction that supported keeping the event in Feira de Santana.

item.title: Fake news contra Flávio é sinal da “degradação moral” do PT, diz Moro
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR) accused the PT of spreading fake news claiming Flávio Bolsonaro aims to strip Nossa Senhora Aparecida of her title as Brazil's patron saint, labeling it a sign of 'moral degradation' of Lula and his party.

item.title: Ministros do Supremo avançam sobre questões eleitorais e ‘atropelam’ TSE em ao menos 4 decisões
item.description: Supreme Court ministers, including Flávio Dino, Gilmar Mendes, and Alexandre de Moraes, have been making decisions on electoral matters ahead of the TSE, increasing tensions within the Court. Minister Dino recently annulled a TSE ruling that had ordered the removal of posts falsely linking senator Flávio Bolsonaro to a legislative bill. These actions reflect an institutional conflict between the STF and TSE, exacerbated by allegations such as the Banco Master case.

item.title: Rogério Marinho esboça planos no Senado em caso de vitória de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Rogério Marinho, campaign coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro, discusses the possibility of running for Senate presidency in case of victory at the Planalto Palace. He highlights priorities such as reform of the Judiciary, term limits for Supreme Court ministers, and impeachment proceedings against magistrates. Marinho also proposes changes to the Senate's internal rules to facilitate the opening of inquiries and responsibility processes against judges.

item.title: Fundo de florestas de Lula bate US$ 7,3 bi com aporte britânico
item.description: The TFFF (Tropical Forests Forever Fund) reached $7.3 billion after the UK announced an investment of £400 million. Created by Brazil at COP30, the fund aims to raise $10 billion by December 31, 2025 to activate initial investments, with participation from Norway, Germany, and France.
